text.name: Phantump

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

text.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Gather Sunlight
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

text.name: Trevenant

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn't even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.

text.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

text.name: Poltchageist

attacks.name: Tea Server
attacks.text: Put a Basic {Grass} Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

text.name: Sinistcha

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Spill the Tea
attacks.text: Discard up to 3 {Grass} Energy cards from your Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.flavor: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

text.name: Fuecoco
text.flavor: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

text.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon

attacks.name: Mountain Stroll
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Ogre Comeback
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

text.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who follow it.

text.name: Mimikyu

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Safeguard
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex and Pokémon V.

attacks.name: Ghost Eye
attacks.text: Put 7 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

text.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Burn It All Up
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

text.name: Chandelure

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Alluring Light
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may have each player draw a card.

attacks.name: Mind Ruler
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

text.name: Greavard

attacks.name: Graveyard Gamboling
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each {Psychic} Pokémon in your discard pile.

text.flavor: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

text.name: Houndstone

attacks.name: Last Respects
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each {Psychic} Pokémon in your discard pile.

text.flavor: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

text.name: Quaxly

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

text.name: Gengar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Night Gate
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nightmare
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

text.name: Scream Tail

attacks.name: Supportive Singing
attacks.text: Heal 100 damage from 1 of your Benched Ancient Pokémon.

text.flavor: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

text.name: Pumpkaboo

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

text.name: Flutter Mane

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Midnight Fluttering
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon has no Abilities, except for Midnight Fluttering.

attacks.name: Hex Hurl
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

text.name: Gourgeist

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Startling Pumpkin
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Shadow Bind
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

text.flavor: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

text.name: Munkidori

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Adrena-Brain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any {Darkness} Energy attached, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

text.flavor: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

text.name: Fezandipiti

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Adrena-Pheromone
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any {Darkness} Energy attached and is damaged by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Energy Feather
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

text.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Mysterious Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

text.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Super Poison Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

text.name: Okidogi

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Adrena-Power
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any {Darkness} Energy attached, it gets +100 HP, and the attacks it uses do 100 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

text.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Feint Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pitch-Black Blade
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

text.flavor: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

text.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Coordinated Pack
attacks.text: For each of your Benched Houndour, search your deck for a Basic {Darkness} Energy card and attach it to that Houndour. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Focus Fangs
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

text.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Daring Strike
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 70 more damage.

attacks.name: Shadow Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

text.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Dark Slumber
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Night Cyclone
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

text.name: Iron Jugulis

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Automated Combat
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

text.flavor: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
